notes: The registered C row is POS_DEAD with LVL_GOD minimum authority.
Leading spaces are skipped and empty argument emits the exact That must be a mistake... refusal without a peer broadcast.
A non-empty message is delivered to every other playing descriptor and retains the actor's own copy.
C removes only leading command whitespace; internal message spacing is preserved in the exact broadcast and actor copy.
PRF_NOREPEAT suppresses the actor's echoed message in favor of C's Okay.\r\n while the other descriptor still receives the global message.
A gecho queued behind C wait-state preserves the original internal and trailing argument spacing when the heartbeat drains it.
